GLP-1s changed my life, and they can change yours too. The hard part is staying on track, so I built GLP-1 Buddy. It reminds you when your weekly shot is due, logs your shots, weight and how you feel, and makes a simple page for your doctor.https://t.co/BmNSpbrkA0
